newsitem.title: USA: U.S. to sell $13.75 bln of 52-wk bills March 26.
newsitem.headline: U.S. to sell $13.75 bln of 52-wk bills March 26.

text.p: The U.S. Treasury said it will auction $13.75 billion of 52-week bills on March 26 to raise $75 million as $13.68 billion of 52-week bills are maturing on April 3.
The bills will be issued April 3 and mature April 2, 1998.
The CUSIP number for the bills will be 9127944T8.
This will be the first auction in which awards to Federal Reserve banks for their own accounts are shown as additions to the offering amount.
Treasury said Fed accounts hold $5.265 billion of the $13.68 billion 52-week issue that matures April 3.
